column1: # Tagalog words whose stress or final glottal stop is not the default (stress on the second-to-
# last syllable, no final glottal stop), respelled with the Filipino accent marks: acute = the
# stressed vowel (mabilis akó, or any syllable: ápat), grave on the final vowel = final glottal
# stop with the default stress (malumi batà), circumflex on the final vowel = stressed final vowel
# with a glottal stop (maragsa hindî). Hand-written; matching: the whole word, lower case, then
# the word without the linker -ng or 't/'y, then its root without prefixes, -um-/-in- and suffixes
# (tl/g2p_tl.py). A whole-word entry may also change letters (Spanish names: jose -> hosé). See
# Spanish names (j and the stress of the Spanish reading)
# More common words (final stress, final glottal stop, Spanish antepenultimate stress)
# Entries without marks keep the default and stop the root lookup (kasama is not ka- + samâ)
